title: Director of Sales Engineering at Celestica Expects ODMs and Rack Integrators to Gain Ground as AI Rack Integration Grows More Complex
expert: Director of Sales Engineering at Celestica (ODM/rack integrator), current
verdict: A current Celestica sales-engineering director sees very strong NVL72/Blackwell demand under supply pressure, with GPUs at 60%-70% of total system cost, but rack integration/test capacity and pay-in-advance terms gate adoption.
